title: cymba mobile and laptop companion-app concept
status: Design concept for review; not integrated into the landing page
generationPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: premium landing-page image for cymba, a neurotechnology earbud brand.
Primary request: Create one exceptionally polished, realistic paired mobile and laptop companion-app concept. The app helps a user start a deep-work session and see brain and pulse signals that inform personalised stimulation timing.

Scene and composition: A silver, ultra-thin unbranded laptop opened on a seamless pure-white studio background, almost front-facing with a subtle three-quarter perspective. An elegant graphite smartphone stands upright in front of the laptop's lower right edge, overlapping only its corner so the main laptop UI remains clearly visible. Entire devices in frame with comfortable margins. Landscape composition, approximately 3:2, as high-resolution as practical. Soft contact shadows only. No desk props, earbuds, people, floating decorative objects, captions, marketing headlines or surrounding webpage. Quiet editorial technology photography, believable materials and crisp screens.

Design direction: Realistic, carefully art-directed software UI. White and very pale warm grey surfaces, near-black text, understated thin borders, restrained violet accent #7958b5, a muted slate-teal pulse trace. Generous negative space. Clear modern sans-serif typography inspired by the existing clean cymba landing page. Avoid generic cluttered dashboards. No glossy purple gradients, giant brain graphics, neon, glassmorphism, decorative circular gauges or cognitive scores. Visually lead with one action, then explain the sensing.

Laptop screen: A refined native-style desktop app with a narrow left navigation sidebar. A lowercase wordmark reading exactly "cymba" at top left, in bold black sans-serif type, no invented emblem. Navigation labels "Session", "Signals", "Settings", with Session selected. In the main content area, heading "Your session" and smaller line "Ready when you are." Below this, a generous primary section with small status "Stimulation off", a concise label "Personalised timing", and one large black rounded button with white text "Start session". Underneath, two elegant horizontally arranged signal cards, titled "Brain activity" and "Pulse", each containing one fine, believable scientific waveform; no invented numerical measurements, performance percentages or axis claims. The cards use fine violet and slate-teal strokes and a very faint baseline. A small understated label "Demo signals" sits above the cards, making it clear they are illustrative. Keep all UI lettering exact and legible. Do not fill every surface.

Phone screen: A responsive, purpose-designed version of the same app, not a squeezed desktop screen. Top lowercase "cymba" wordmark. Heading "Your session". Small status "Stimulation off". One quietly styled card labelled "Personalised timing", with two miniature waveform rows labelled "Brain activity" and "Pulse". Small "Demo signals" label. A prominent black rounded "Start session" button in the lower portion with ample comfortable space. Three understated bottom navigation items "Session", "Signals", "Settings", Session active. Balanced spacious composition and readable screen text.

Constraints: These are companion-app design mockups, not evidence of a finished app. Do not claim improved cognition, validated benefits, focus scores, clinical results, fixed treatment/session lengths, cloud storage, Bluetooth pairing, battery status or operating-system compatibility. No Apple, Windows, Android or other manufacturer logos. No watermarks. All device screens must be anatomically and perspectively plausible with clean rectangular proportions and undistorted text. One coherent visual system across both devices.
refinementPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied cymba paired laptop and phone app mockup. Keep every device, perspective, screen layout, wordmark, text label, button, colour, brain-activity graph and white studio background exactly unchanged. Change ONLY the two teal traces labelled "Pulse" (one on the laptop, one on the phone). They currently resemble ECG with thin sharp QRS spikes. Replace both with correct optical PPG pulse waveforms: repeated smooth rounded arterial pulse waves, each with a fairly quick upward slope, one rounded systolic peak, a slower downward slope with a small dicrotic notch and secondary shoulder, then return to baseline. Continuous smooth curves, modest amplitude, no needle-like spikes, no negative ECG troughs. Approximately five cycles on the laptop and four on the phone. Preserve the fine slate-teal stroke and original baseline and chart dimensions. These remain illustrative demo signals. Do not change anything else.
notes: Illustrative interface and demo signals. No finished companion app or platform compatibility is established by this concept.
